sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Japanese toy company Bandai has reimagined its cult video game Tamagotchi as a miniature wearable so fans can always have their digital pet to hand. Designed to mark the product's 30th anniversary, the playable ring is only 28 millimetres long – nearly half the size of the original Tamagotchi from 1996.
